content:
Here is the text reimagined in the classic 4chan "greentext" and rant style:

>be me
>19, lonely as fuck
>all I want is to hold a boy's hand
>doesn't even have to be a specific one, just want the warmth
>imagine walking down the hall, holding hands, getting lined up against the wall of public rejection
>everyone whispering and ostracizing us for existing
>why does anyone give a shit?
>love is love, right?
>the irony of the hate is astounding
>it feels so dissociative hearing normies casually insult people like me in conversation as if I’m not even in the room
>my social life is basically non-existent because I’m trapped in this closet
>if I ever step out, it’s game over
>all I want is to wear a skirt and be a cute girly boy
>why is the world this fucked up?
>why am I like this?
>pic related (it’s just a depressed Pepe)
